svg.text: State: Success (Feature 5, Scenario "Generating all three Build Targets")
$ md-publisher-cli generate user-guide --targets docx,pdf,web
✓ dist/user-guide.docx
✓ dist/user-guide.pdf
✓ dist/user-guide/ (web)
3 Build Targets generated from 3 Documents, 0 Structure Violations.
State: Refused (Feature 5, Scenario "Generation refused on an unresolved Structure Violation")
$ md-publisher-cli generate user-guide --targets docx,pdf,web
✗ Structure Violation in chapter-2.mdpub
Cross-Reference "#setup" does not match any heading in the Publication
No Output Artifact was produced. Fix the violation and run again.
exit code 1
State: Partial (Feature 6, Scenario "EPUB-specific structural requirement missing")
$ md-publisher-cli generate field-notes --targets epub,pdf
✗ Build-Target Violation: epub
No chapter is marked as the table-of-contents source
✓ dist/field-notes.pdf
1 of 2 Build Targets produced. epub failed independently of pdf (BR-7).
exit code 1
Interaction notes
Triggered by (When): "md-publisher-cli generate <publication> --targets ..." (Features 3, 5, 6).
State 1 satisfies Feature 5's "an OutputArtifact is produced for each of the three Build Targets."
State 2 satisfies Feature 5's "the Generator refuses ... the Structure Violation is reported instead."
State 3 satisfies Feature 6's "a BuildTargetViolation is raised for Epub ... the Pdf OutputArtifact is still produced."
From here: fix the Document and re-run (loops back to this screen), or open the Editor (screen 2) to see the
same violation live — see 07-ux-design.md's screen-flow diagram.
